name: Upwork
description: The world's largest platform for professional freelancers.
detailed_overview: Upwork connects Kenyan talent with global clients. It is ideal for writers, developers, and virtual assistants looking for long-term contracts.
kenya_specific_tips: Link your Upwork account to a local bank like Equity or KCB for the best exchange rates.

name: Fiverr
description: An online marketplace for freelance services starting at $5.
detailed_overview: Unlike Upwork where you bid for jobs, on Fiverr, clients come to you. You create specific service packages.
kenya_specific_tips: Focus on niches with less competition, such as Swahili translation or local Kenyan voice-overs.

name: Freelancer.com
description: A global freelancing and crowdsourcing marketplace.
detailed_overview: Freelancer.com allows you to bid on projects ranging from data entry to software development.
kenya_specific_tips: Use the 'Preferred Freelancer' program if you have a strong portfolio to stand out.

name: Toptal
description: An exclusive network for the top 3% of freelance talent.
detailed_overview: Toptal is for highly skilled developers, designers, and finance experts. The screening process is rigorous but the pay is excellent.
kenya_specific_tips: Ensure your GitHub or portfolio is pristine before applying.

name: PeoplePerHour
description: A UK-based freelance marketplace popular in Kenya.
detailed_overview: PeoplePerHour offers a mix of hourly projects and fixed-price 'Hours'. It is very friendly to African freelancers.
kenya_specific_tips: Create 'Hourlies' (fixed price offers) to attract buyers quickly without bidding.

name: Guru
description: One of the oldest freelance platforms with a focus on long-term relationships.
detailed_overview: Guru provides a SafePay system to ensure you get paid for your work. It is great for administrative and technical roles.
kenya_specific_tips: Look for 'WorkRoom' projects which allow for better collaboration with clients.

name: FlexJobs
description: A curated job board for remote and flexible work.
detailed_overview: FlexJobs screens every job posting to ensure it is legitimate. It requires a subscription but saves time on scams.
kenya_specific_tips: Use the advanced search filters to find jobs specifically open to 'Worldwide' candidates.

name: SolidGigs
description: A service that sends you the best 1% of freelance jobs daily.
detailed_overview: Instead of searching for hours, SolidGigs curates high-paying leads and sends them to your inbox.
kenya_specific_tips: Great for established freelancers who want to skip the bidding phase.

name: Contra
description: A professional network for independents with zero commission fees.
detailed_overview: Contra allows you to showcase your work and get hired without the platform taking a cut of your earnings.
kenya_specific_tips: Use Contra as your primary portfolio link when pitching clients on social media.

name: Workana
description: The largest freelance platform in Latin America, now global.
detailed_overview: Workana is expanding globally and offers many opportunities for Spanish and English speakers.
kenya_specific_tips: If you know any Spanish, this platform is a goldmine for Kenyans.

name: Exness
description: A global forex broker known for instant withdrawals.
detailed_overview: Exness is a top choice for Kenyan traders due to its M-Pesa integration and high leverage options.
kenya_specific_tips: Start with a standard cent account to practice risk management.

name: HFM (HotForex)
description: A multi-award-winning broker with a strong African presence.
detailed_overview: HFM offers a wide range of trading instruments and regular promotions for Kenyan traders.
kenya_specific_tips: Read the terms and conditions of any bonus carefully before accepting it.

name: FxPesa
description: A forex broker tailored for the East African market.
detailed_overview: FxPesa focuses on providing a seamless experience for Kenyan traders with local payment options.
kenya_specific_tips: Take advantage of their local webinars to learn trading strategies.

name: Scope Markets
description: A broker offering diverse trading conditions.
detailed_overview: Scope Markets provides various account types suitable for both beginners and professional traders.
kenya_specific_tips: Choose the right account type based on your trading style.

name: Pepperstone
description: An award-winning global forex broker.
detailed_overview: Pepperstone is known for its fast execution and tight spreads, making it a favorite for scalpers.
kenya_specific_tips: Use a Visa card linked to your bank for faster deposits.

name: XM
description: A global forex and CFD broker.
detailed_overview: XM is known for its excellent customer service and educational webinars.
kenya_specific_tips: Open a Micro account to start trading with very small lot sizes.

name: IQ Option
description: A platform for trading binary options and digital options.
detailed_overview: IQ Option offers a unique trading interface where you predict if the price will go up or down.
kenya_specific_tips: Treat binary options as high-risk speculation.

name: FXTM
description: A global broker with a strong focus on education.
detailed_overview: FXTM offers a variety of account types and is well-regulated.
kenya_specific_tips: Participate in their trading contests to practice your skills.

name: OctaFX
description: A global forex broker with a strong presence in Kenya.
detailed_overview: OctaFX is known for its social trading features, allowing beginners to copy trades.
kenya_specific_tips: Use the OctaSpace copier to automate your trading.

name: Binance
description: The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange.
detailed_overview: Binance provides a platform for Kenyans to buy, sell, and trade cryptocurrencies.
kenya_specific_tips: Use the P2P section to buy USDT directly from other Kenyans using M-Pesa.

name: Coinbase
description: A user-friendly platform for buying and selling crypto.
detailed_overview: Coinbase is known for its security and ease of use.
kenya_specific_tips: Use Coinbase Learn to earn small amounts of crypto while learning.

name: Bybit
description: A leading crypto exchange for derivatives and spot trading.
detailed_overview: Bybit is popular for its advanced trading features and high liquidity in the derivatives market.
kenya_specific_tips: Use Bybit's P2P platform for competitive USDT rates in Kenya.

name: KuCoin
description: The people's exchange with a wide variety of altcoins.
detailed_overview: KuCoin lists many new tokens early, making it a favorite for altcoin hunters.
kenya_specific_tips: Explore the 'KuCoin Earn' section for passive income on your holdings.

name: OKX
description: A comprehensive crypto platform with a powerful Web3 wallet.
detailed_overview: OKX combines a centralized exchange with a decentralized Web3 wallet.
kenya_specific_tips: Use the OKX Web3 wallet to explore DeFi opportunities safely.

name: Trust Wallet
description: A decentralized mobile wallet for cryptocurrencies.
detailed_overview: Trust Wallet allows you to store your crypto securely and interact with DeFi.
kenya_specific_tips: Never share your 12-word recovery phrase with anyone.

name: MetaMask
description: The most popular wallet for interacting with Ethereum and DeFi.
detailed_overview: MetaMask is a bridge between your browser and the blockchain.
kenya_specific_tips: Use MetaMask to explore lower-fee networks like Polygon.

name: Ledger
description: The gold standard for secure crypto storage.
detailed_overview: Ledger devices keep your private keys offline, protecting you from online hacks.
kenya_specific_tips: Only buy Ledger devices from authorized sellers to avoid tampered units.

name: Risevest
description: An automated investment platform for Africans.
detailed_overview: Risevest allows Kenyans to invest in dollar-denominated assets like US stocks and real estate.
kenya_specific_tips: Start with the 'Stable' portfolio if you are risk-averse.

name: Bamboo App
description: An app for investing in US and Nigerian stocks.
detailed_overview: Bamboo makes it easy for Kenyans to buy shares in companies like Apple or Tesla.
kenya_specific_tips: Use Bamboo to diversify your portfolio beyond the NSE.

name: Ndovu
description: A digital wealth manager for Kenyans.
detailed_overview: Ndovu creates personalized investment portfolios based on your goals.
kenya_specific_tips: Use Ndovu for long-term goals like education or retirement.

name: Chumz
description: A social savings and investment app.
detailed_overview: Chumz allows groups of friends or family to save and invest together.
kenya_specific_tips: Set clear rules for your chama within the app.

name: Mbao PSC
description: A licensed money market fund in Kenya.
detailed_overview: Mbao PSC offers competitive interest rates on savings with low entry thresholds.
kenya_specific_tips: Ideal for parking emergency funds while earning better than bank rates.

name: Etopari
description: A platform for investing in digital assets and startups.
detailed_overview: Etopari provides access to alternative investments for the modern Kenyan investor.
kenya_specific_tips: Diversify your portfolio across different asset classes on the platform.

name: Wealth Masters
description: A community focused on financial literacy and investment.
detailed_overview: Wealth Masters provides education and tools for Kenyans to build wealth through various channels.
kenya_specific_tips: Engage actively in the community to learn from experienced investors.

name: Surveytime
description: Earn $1 for every survey you complete.
detailed_overview: Surveytime simplifies the survey process by offering a flat rate.
kenya_specific_tips: Complete your profile thoroughly to increase your chances of qualifying.

name: Toloka
description: A platform for completing small tasks to help improve AI.
detailed_overview: Toloka allows users to earn money by performing simple tasks like image classification.
kenya_specific_tips: Focus on 'field tasks' if you live in Nairobi or Mombasa.

name: Clickworker
description: Clickworker offers micro-jobs and AI training tasks.
detailed_overview: Clickworker is known for its UHRS integration, which provides a steady stream of tasks.
kenya_specific_tips: Take the UHRS assessment seriously; it is the key to unlocking high-paying tasks.

name: Remotasks
description: A platform for completing micro-tasks that help train AI systems.
detailed_overview: Remotasks has been a popular entry point for many Kenyans into the online earning space.
kenya_specific_tips: Many Kenyan users prefer using AirTM to convert their earnings into M-Pesa.

name: Lionbridge
description: A global company providing AI training and localization services.
detailed_overview: Lionbridge offers remote opportunities for search engine evaluation and map analysis.
kenya_specific_tips: Look for 'Rater' or 'Evaluator' positions which are frequently opened for Kenyans.

name: Appen
description: A global leader in data annotation and collection for AI.
detailed_overview: Appen connects people with projects that help machine learning models understand the world.
kenya_specific_tips: Keep your profile updated with new skills to qualify for more projects.

name: Swagbucks
description: Earn points for surveys, watching videos, and shopping online.
detailed_overview: Swagbucks is one of the oldest rewards sites. Kenyans can earn through specific surveys and shopping portals.
requirements: US/UK IP sometimes required for best tasks
kenya_specific_tips: Use a reliable browser and keep your profile updated to maximize survey matches.

name: Yaga
description: Kenya's premier online fashion marketplace.
detailed_overview: Yaga allows individuals and boutiques to sell pre-loved and new fashion items to a targeted audience.
kenya_specific_tips: Use natural light for your product photos to increase sales significantly.

name: Jiji
description: A free classifieds site for buying and selling in Kenya.
detailed_overview: Jiji is the go-to place for selling anything from electronics to cars in Kenya.
kenya_specific_tips: Always meet in public places and verify M-Pesa messages before handing over goods.

name: Facebook Marketplace
description: Buy and sell items within your local community on Facebook.
detailed_overview: Facebook Marketplace leverages your social network to help you sell items quickly.
kenya_specific_tips: Join specific 'Buy and Sell' groups in your area for better reach.

name: Sky Garden
description: An online mall connecting shoppers with verified sellers.
detailed_overview: Sky Garden offers a curated shopping experience with a focus on quality and reliability.
kenya_specific_tips: Provide excellent customer service to get featured on their homepage.

name: Masoko
description: A Kenyan e-commerce platform for a wide range of products.
detailed_overview: Masoko aims to provide a seamless online shopping experience for Kenyans.
kenya_specific_tips: Use their promotional tools to boost your product visibility.
